page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew/Aramaic script and Latin; no marginal notes; signature "Tt 3" at foot.

main_text.p: מַטְלָא מַטַל Ch.Onus: Prophetia,onerosa proprie,quę calamitatum ac poenarum onus apportat. Nonunquam scribitur מַטַל ut Nah.1.1, prave. Heb. מַשָּׂא.
מַטּוּלָא מטול Ch.Onus, Pondus, Sarcina: Item Profectio, Deut.10.11. Plur. מטולי, מטולין.
מַטְלַן Ch. Profectio. Plur. מטלני, מטלנין.
נְטַף Ch. Stillare, destillare, ut Hebr. Pahel נְטַף Idē. Aphel אַטִּיף Idem.
נְטוּפָא, נְטוּפָא Ch.Gutta,Stilla: Synecdochicè, Stacte, Resina,Opobalsamum, Exo.30.34. Ruth.4.20. Sed hoc in loco videtur esse nomen proprium.

נְטַר Ch.& Syr. Servare, asservare, conservare, observare,custodire: Pahel נְטַר Idē. Ithpeh. אִתְנְטַר, Servari, conservari, custodiri. נְטַר סְנָא vel דִּבְּנוּ Observavit inimicitiā vel odium, phrasis frequens pro שְׂטֵם vel שְׂנָא Odio habuit vel prosecutus est, ut Ps.55.4. Genes.27.41. Deut.19.4. in Jon. Genes.37.4.5.8.in Jon.
נָטוֹר, נָטֵר Ch. & Syr. Custodiens, custos, observator. Plur. נְטָרִין, נְטָרִי: & נְטוּרִי. Foemin. נְטָרָא. Syr. ܢܛܪܝܐ Custodiens portam, Janitrix, Joh.18.16.
ܢܛܘܪܝܐ Syr. Idem. Plur. ܢܛܘܪܐ Custodes, Act.5.23.
נָטִיר Ch.Observabilis: לֵיל נָטִיר Nox observabilis, Exo. 12.42. בְּנָטִיר Cum custodia, clam, secreto, Jobi 4.12.
ܢܛܘܪܬܐ & ܢܛܘܪܬܐ Syr. Observationes, Lucae 17. 20. & 1.ad Cor.7.19.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac script is transcribed approximately; vowel points and some letter forms are uncertain and may contain errors. The page number 333 is printed at the top left.
